## Mac and Linux (beta)

- STL Editor now has desktop builds for Mac and Linux, marked **beta**. They work like the Windows version, but they are new and less tested. If something goes wrong, the web edition is the safe choice.
- **Mac:** Apple Silicon only (the M-series chips). Intel Macs should use the web edition for now.
- The Mac app isn't signed or notarized by Apple yet, so macOS blocks it the first time you open it. Open **System Settings › Privacy & Security** and click **Open Anyway**. You can also run `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine "STL Editor.app"` in Terminal after unzipping.
- Move the Mac app to your Applications folder first. Updates can't replace an app that is still running from the download folder.
- **Linux:** download the `.tar.gz`, extract it, and run the **STL Editor** program inside the folder. Nothing to install.
- **Send to Slicer** on Mac and Linux finds Bambu Studio, OrcaSlicer and PrusaSlicer.
- **To STEP** is still Windows only.

## Windows: no change

- The Windows portable zip works as before. Its download link and steps are the same.
